terms.title: Timeline & Delivery
points: Illustration Only: 3–6 weeks (excluding revisions, depending on complexity)
Rigging Only: 2–6 weeks (excluding revisions, depending on complexity)
Drawing & Rigging Combo: 5–8 weeks (excluding revisions, depending on complexity)
Rush orders can be accommodated with an agreed express rush fee
Final source files delivered via Google Drive and Email

terms.title: Payment & Installments
points: Full Payment: 50% deposit before work starts, remaining 50% upon completion
Installments: Promotional installment plans supported up to 7 months
Production schedule begins upon 1st installment; final files released upon 100% completion

terms.title: Terms & Policies
points: 3 free revisions included per production phase (Additional adjustments: +฿10/point)
Deposits are non-refundable under all circumstances if client cancels
If client becomes unresponsive or fails to pay agreed schedule, project will be terminated with forfeiture of deposit
The studio reserves the right to pursue appropriate legal remedies for contractual breaches
